name: The Missing Scholar

angles.text: As a mage, you share Fillion Flamebreeze’s training in the arcane arts. He relies on that training to recover and travel safely.

faq.answer: Fillion Flamebreeze is a scholar skilled in the arcane arts. He was on an assignment near Valanaar before becoming stranded near a nest of dangerous beasts.
Shrieklings are hostile beasts nesting in a nearby den close to Valanaar. Their presence threatens anyone traveling in the area.
The Supreme Magister is Elaadrin Evengale, who leads the High Order in Valanaar. Fillion reports the events at the den and the status of his mission to them.
Valanaar is the nearby settlement where Fillion is stationed. He returns there once he has recovered enough to travel.

aliases: who to kill in shriekling den
faq.answer: The Shriekling Matriarch leads the shrieklings nesting in the Shriekling Den. Fillion asks you to slay her and bring back her head to end the immediate danger to Valanaar.
The shrieklings threaten Valanaar because they nest so close to the settlement. When you return, Fillion says they are only the least of their troubles.
faq.q: Why does Fillion consider the shrieklings the least of their troubles?

sections.body: After his ordeal, Fillion Flamebreeze can travel back toward the safety of Valanaar. Yet a brood of shrieklings has nested close to the settlement. Fillion asks you to enter the Shriekling Den and slay the Shriekling Matriarch before the beasts threaten the town.
sections.title: A Perilous Nesting Ground

sections.body: When you bring the Matriarch’s head to Fillion in Valanaar, he thanks you. Yet the shrieklings are only the least of their troubles. Fillion prepares to report on his mission and the surrounding area to the Supreme Magister.
sections.title: Reporting to the Magister

summary: Fillion Flamebreeze is stranded near a dangerous den, and Valanaar needs the threat ended. Once he can travel, he asks you to slay the Shriekling Matriarch nearby.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Missing Scholar
